PurposeFounder-level command board for committed revenue, weighted pipeline, revenue quality, slippage risk, quote-to-contract confidence, and capital/cash permissions across the next selling window.
Source ruleUpdate sales pipeline, active deal rooms, pricing governance, proforma and contract status, cash forecast, concentration review, assumption control, quarterly plan, and linked deal source records first, then refresh this review.
Founder useDecide which revenue can be trusted, which should stay weighted, which must be downgraded, and which should not receive release, capital, or founder attention until proof improves.
Protection ruleThis dashboard governs forecast posture only; approved templates, brand assets, and source-record protections stay unchanged.

Revenue Quality Control PostureLink

Control lensCurrent postureFounder readRequired response
Commitment qualityCommitted revenue is credible, but still concentrated in a narrow deal set.Forecast confidence is useful only if commitment quality, cash timing, and margin quality hold together.Tie committed and high-confidence revenue to contract, cash, release, and profitability proof.
Weighted pipeline qualityWeighted upside exists, but some paths still depend on supplier slot and pricing assumptions.Weighted revenue should not quietly consume capital or release capacity.Keep weighted deals behind assumption control, supply resilience, and capital allocation gates.
Stretch disciplineJuly upside still has too much early-stage optimism.Stretch revenue is a planning signal, not operating permission.Demote stretch items when qualification or source proof fails to improve.
Cash linkageForecast quality depends on collection and release discipline, not only deal probability.Revenue that creates cash exposure is lower quality revenue.Route cash-sensitive commitments through cash forecast, collections, and credit/release controls.
Concentration riskTop revenue paths overlap with top customer and product concentration.Growth can increase fragility if it concentrates around the same accounts and garlic-led mix.Use concentration review before widening confidence bands or capital support.

Forecast Band RulesLink

Forecast bandRequired proofNot allowedFounder use
CommittedSigned or equivalent commercial commitment, release posture, cash path, margin view, and owner handoff are current.Treating verbal confidence as committed revenue.Use for operating plan and near-term cash expectations.
High-confidencePricing, payment, source, and customer timing evidence are current enough to support likely conversion.Ignoring unresolved concessions, cash exposure, or source gaps.Use for active founder attention and controlled capital planning.
WeightedDeal is real but still depends on assumptions, source proof, or buyer action.Consuming release capacity or cash support as if committed.Use for monitored upside with proof gates.
StretchEarly opportunity has strategic relevance but limited proof.Allowing stretch to inflate plan quality or capital release.Use for pipeline ambition only.
DowngradedProof weakens, source date slips, or confidence depends on founder rescue.Leaving forecast band unchanged after evidence changes.Route to recovery, risk, or owner accountability.

Revenue Quality GatesLink

GateRequired evidenceIf currentIf weak
Pricing and margin gatePricing review, concession logic, profitability view, and recovery path are current.Forecast band can hold.Downgrade band or hold quote release.
Cash and collection gateCash forecast, collections path, credit posture, and release dependency are current.Revenue can support cash planning.Keep revenue out of committed cash assumptions.
Source and capacity gateSupplier slot, backup posture, and shipment feasibility are current.Weighted revenue can move toward high-confidence.Keep revenue weighted or downgrade stretch.
Customer trust gateAccount posture, response quality, trust tier, and decision boundaries are current.Customer commitment can support confidence.Require founder decision or trust-posture review before widening.
Capital permission gateCapital allocation confirms release, cash, and capacity support.Forecast can influence resource priority.Do not allocate scarce cash or release capacity to the deal.
